```{r data_import}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, 
  warning = FALSE, 
  message = FALSE, 
  error = FALSE,
  fig.pos = 'H',
  out.width = "100%")

source("Libraries.R")
merged_data <- read.csv("Input/merged_data.csv")

# metto a posto la tipologia di variabile
cols_date <- c("Data_di_nascita", "Data_esordio", "Data_diagnosi", "Data_prelievo_T0", "data_referto_T6", "data_referto_T12", "data_referto_T18", "data_referto_T24", "data_referto_T30", "data_referto_T36", "data_cambio_terapia", "sample_collection_date", "glc_date_before_t0")
merged_data[cols_date] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_date], as.Date)
cols_factor <- c("lesioni_T6", "relapse_T6", "lesioni_T12", "relapse_T12",
                "lesioni_T18", "relapse_T18", "lesioni_T24", "relapse_T24",
                "lesioni_T30", "relapse_T30", "lesioni_T36", "relapse_T36",
                "cambio_terapia", "lesion_burden", "bone_marrow_lesions",
                "subtentorial_lesions", "gadolinium_contrast", "full_recovery", "naive", "smoking_habit", "antibiotic_use", "spike_in")
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(cols_factor), ~ case_when(
      .x %in% c("No", "no", "0", 0) ~ "No",
      .x %in% c("Yes", "yes", "1", 1) ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("No", "Yes"))))

cols_factor2 <- c("glucocorticoid_treatment", "gc_treatment", "prognosis_at_onset")
merged_data[cols_factor2] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_factor2], factor, levels = c("Positive", "Negative")) # DT qui i livelli erano maiuscoli e, dato che non matchavano, dava valori NA a tutto
merged_data$physical_activity <- factor(merged_data$physical_activity, levels = c("active", "sedentary", "partially_active"))
merged_data$simplified_batch <- factor(merged_data$simplified_batch, levels = c("1-3", "4-5"))
merged_data$disease_activity <- factor(merged_data$disease_activity, levels = c("higher_activity", "lower_activity"))
merged_data$sex <- factor(merged_data$sex, levels = c("M", "F"))
merged_data$sequencing_batch <- factor(merged_data$sequencing_batch, levels = c("1", "2", "3"))
merged_data$CENTRO <- factor(merged_data$CENTRO, levels = c("CLERICO", "NAPOLI", "MOLINETTE", "CRESM"))
merged_data$clinical_presentation <- factor(merged_data$clinical_presentation)

merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("EDSS"), ~ {x_char <- trimws(as.character(.x))
    ordered(x_char, levels = as.character(seq(0, 10, by = 0.5)))}))

cols_numeric <- c("MEDAS", "cortisone_T6", "cortisone_T12", "cortisone_T18", "cortisone_T24", "cortisone_T30", "cortisone_T36", "age_at_t0", "bmi", "dna_quantification", "days_gc_collection", "percent_th17", "treg_il10_pos", "treg_cd39_pos", "age")
merged_data[cols_numeric] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_numeric], as.numeric)

#Pulizia x evitare crash LaTeX
merged_data$NOTE <- gsub("[#$%&_]", " ", merged_data$NOTE)
merged_data$nuova_terapia <- gsub("[#$%&_]", " ", merged_data$nuova_terapia)
merged_data$previous_therapy <- gsub("[#$%&_]", " ", merged_data$previous_therapy)
```

```{r summary_data}
summary(merged_data)
```


The cohort is composed by 30 patients affected by multiple sclerosis recruited from multiple centers (Clerico, Molinette, Napoli, CRESM).
All of them were treated with cladribine (Mavenclad).
The longitudinal clinical data were collected at 6-month time-points for 3 years.

The population is predominantly female, with 21 females (70.0%) and 9 males (30.0%).
At baseline (T0), the mean age was 37.37 years (± 9.89), with a median of 38.50 years, ranging from 20 to 55 years, indicating a relatively young cohort.
Disease activity was predominantly classified as higher activity.
Disability at baseline, measured by EDSS, showed generally low values reflected by a median of 1.5 and 26.7% of patients with a EDSS 1. 
Regarding treatment history, 18 patients (60.0%) were naive, while 11 (36.7%) had received prior therapies.
Glucocorticoid treatment before T0 was reported in 12 patients (40.0%), whereas 6 patients (20.0%) had not received such treatment and data were missing for 12 subjects.

Regarding lifestyle factors, the mean body mass index (BMI) was 23.54 ± 4.85, ranging from 16.80 to 32.10, with 9 missing values.
Adherence to the Mediterranean diet, assessed by the MEDAS score (from 0 to 100), showed a mean value of 50.55 ± 15.18, with a wide range (35.00–85.70) and 8 missing observations.
7 patients (23.3%) are smokers and 17 (56.7%) are non-smokers, with 6 missing values.
Physical activity is heterogeneously distributed among the cohort with 5 (16.7%) patients classified as active, 7 (23.3%) as partially active and 9 (30%) as sedentary, with 9 missing values.

```{r summary_table}

####tabella riassuntiva
#variabili numeriche
tab_num <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("percent_th17", "treg_cd39_pos", "treg_il10_pos"))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "val") %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = unique(names(merged_data)))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(variable) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    All = paste0(round(mean(val, na.rm = TRUE), 2), " ± ", round(sd(val, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
    `N missing` = as.character(sum(is.na(val))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#variabili categoriche
vars_cat <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::select(where(~is.factor(.) | is.character(.) | is.ordered(.)), 
                -any_of(c("ID", "NOTE", "nuova_terapia", "previous_therapy", "sample_type"))) %>%
  colnames()
lista_cat <- lapply(vars_cat, function(v) {
  miss_count <- as.character(sum(is.na(merged_data[[v]])))
  
levels_df <- merged_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(level = as.character(!!sym(v))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(level)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      All = paste0(n, " (", round((n / nrow(merged_data)) * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `N missing` = ""
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(variable = paste0("   ", level)) %>%
    dplyr::select(variable, All, `N missing`)
  
  bind_rows(
    tibble(variable = v, All = "", `N missing` = miss_count),
    levels_df
  )
})

tab_cat <- bind_rows(lista_cat)

#unione 
summary_table <- bind_rows(tab_num, tab_cat)

#tolgo i simboli che mandano in crash latex
summary_table$variable <- gsub("_", " ", summary_table$variable)
summary_table$All <- gsub("%", "\\\\%", summary_table$All)

knitr::kable(summary_table, caption = "Cohort Summary Table")
```

Summary linepoint of the trend of the EDSS variable over time for each patient in the cohort:
```{r lineplot}
edss_long <- merged_data %>%
  select(ID, starts_with("EDSS_T")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("EDSS_T"), 
    names_to = "timepoint", 
    values_to = "EDSS"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(EDSS)) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, 
                            levels = paste0("EDSS_T", c(0, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36)),
                            labels = paste0("T", c(0, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36))))
#creo grafico
ggplot(edss_long, aes(x = timepoint, y = EDSS, group = ID)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = ID), alpha = 0.6, size = 0.6) + 
  #jitter
  geom_point(aes(color = ID), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2, position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0, seed = 42)) +
  #aggiungo etichette ID
  geom_text_repel(data = edss_long %>% 
      group_by(ID) %>% 
      filter(as.numeric(timepoint) == max(as.numeric(timepoint))),
    aes(label = ID, color = ID), size = 3, fontface = "bold", nudge_x = 0.2, segment.alpha = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  #Linea media
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 1.3, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2.5, color = "black", shape = 18) + 
  #correzione colori per averli più distinti
  scale_color_manual(values = as.vector(pals::polychrome(length(unique(edss_long$ID)))), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "EDSS Progression Over Time", 
       subtitle = "Black: cohort average | Coloured: each MAV patient", 
       x = "Timepoints", y = "EDSS value" ) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"), 
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14), 
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey30"),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 40, 10, 10)) #aggiungo spazio per gli ID
```


Exploratory analysis of some relevant demographic variables:
1. EDSS and age at T0, positive and significant difference between groups only in T24 and T30 time-points (we have to consider that these two time-points have a larger number of NA).
```{r EDSS_vs_Age}

# EDSS vs age_at_t0
cor.test(merged_data$age_at_t0, as.numeric(merged_data$EDSS_T0), method = "spearman", exact = FALSE) # non significativo
cor.test(merged_data$age_at_t0, as.numeric(merged_data$EDSS_T12), method = "spearman", exact = FALSE) # non significativo
cor.test(merged_data$age_at_t0, as.numeric(merged_data$EDSS_T24), method = "spearman", exact = FALSE) #SIGNIFICATIVO
cor.test(merged_data$age_at_t0, as.numeric(merged_data$EDSS_T30), method = "spearman", exact = FALSE) #SIGNIFICATIVO

# linee di regressione EDSS vs age_at_t0
ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = age_at_t0, y = as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)))) + geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "EDSS vs Age at T0", x = "Age at T0", y = "EDSS T0")
ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = age_at_t0, y = as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T24)))) + geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "EDSS vs Age at T0", x = "Age at T0", y = "EDSS T24")
```


2. EDSS and sex, non-significant difference between groups at all time points.

3. EDSS and physical activity, a possible trend can be seen in the graph between the sedentary lifestyle and an increase in the disability index (EDSS), but the statistical test is not significant.

```{r EDSS_vs_physical_activity}
## EDSS vs physical_activity

#T0
kruskal.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)) ~ physical_activity, data = merged_data)
ggplot(subset(merged_data, !is.na(physical_activity) & !is.na(EDSS_T0)), aes(x = physical_activity, y = as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)), fill = physical_activity)) + geom_boxplot() + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "EDSS vs Physical_activity", x = "Physical_activity", y = "EDSS_T0")

kruskal.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T6)) ~ physical_activity, data = merged_data) 
kruskal.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T12)) ~ physical_activity, data = merged_data) 
kruskal.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T18)) ~ physical_activity, data = merged_data) 

#T24
kruskal.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T24)) ~ physical_activity, data = merged_data)
ggplot(subset(merged_data, !is.na(physical_activity) & !is.na(EDSS_T24)), aes(x = physical_activity, y = as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T24)), fill = physical_activity)) + geom_boxplot() + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "EDSS vs Physical_activity", x = "Physical_activity", y = "EDSS_T24")

kruskal.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T30)) ~ physical_activity, data = merged_data) 
kruskal.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T36)) ~ physical_activity, data = merged_data) 

#andamento totale
edss_long <- merged_data %>%
  select(ID, smoking_habit, sex, naive, physical_activity, EDSS_T0, EDSS_T6, EDSS_T12, EDSS_T18, EDSS_T24, EDSS_T30) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("EDSS"), names_to = "time", values_to = "EDSS_val") %>%
  mutate(EDSS_val = as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_val)), sex = trimws(as.character(sex)), time = factor(time, levels = c("EDSS_T0","EDSS_T6","EDSS_T12","EDSS_T18","EDSS_T24","EDSS_T30"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(EDSS_val))
ggplot(edss_long, aes(x = time, y = EDSS_val, color = physical_activity, group = physical_activity)) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", size = 3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal() + labs(title="EDSS during time by Physical Activity", x = "Time", y = "Median EDSS")
```

3. EDSS and lesion burden, non-significant difference between groups at all time points, but looking at the graph you can notice a possible trend of association of higher EDSS values to patients with lesions.

```{r EDSS_vs_lesion_burden}

#lesion burden
wilcox.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)) ~ lesion_burden, data = merged_data, exact = FALSE) 
wilcox.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T12)) ~ lesion_burden, data = merged_data, exact = FALSE) 

merged_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(EDSS_T0), !is.na(lesion_burden)) %>%
  mutate(
    EDSS_T0 = as.factor(EDSS_T0),
    lesion_burden = factor(lesion_burden, labels = c("No", "Yes"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = lesion_burden, fill = EDSS_T0)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako") + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "EDSS T0 by lesion burden", x = "Lesion burden", y = "Percentage", fill = "EDSS")
```

```{r EDSS_vs_bone_marrow_lesions}
#Bone marrow lesions
wilcox.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)) ~ bone_marrow_lesions, data = merged_data, exact = FALSE)

merged_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(EDSS_T12), !is.na(bone_marrow_lesions)) %>%
  mutate(
    EDSS_T12 = as.factor(EDSS_T12),
    bone_marrow_lesions = factor(bone_marrow_lesions, labels = c("No", "Yes"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bone_marrow_lesions, fill = EDSS_T12)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako") + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "EDSS T12 by bone marrow lesions", x = "Bone marrow lesions", y = "Percentage", fill = "EDSS")
```


7. Glucocorticoid treatment before baseline and EDSS, significant positive difference between groups in the T0 timepoint.

```{r EDSS_vs_gc_treatment}
#glucocorticoid treatment before T0 e edss T0 #SIGNIFICATIVO
wilcox.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)) ~ gc_treatment, data = merged_data)
ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = gc_treatment, y = as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)))) + geom_boxplot() + theme_minimal() + labs(title= "Glucocorticoid treatment before T0", x= "gc treatment", y="EDSS T0")
```

Overall, no statistically significant associations were observed between EDSS and most clinical or lifestyle variables across time points. Notably, a significant positive association was observed between EDSS and bone marrow lesions, specifically at the T12 time-point. Additionally, glucocorticoid treatment showed a significant positive difference between groups at T0.
Regarding age, while age at baseline was generally associated with higher EDSS values at later stages, a specific positive and significant difference was found between age at T0 and the presence of lesions at both T6 and T12.
Physical activity showed a potential trend, with more sedentary patients displaying a higher EDSS values over time, but the statistical tests are not significant. Although these results remain robust, it is important to consider that the findings at later time points may be partially influenced by missing data.
